timestamp_correction.why: recorder spin-thread starvation; rows stamped at callback time were depth/rate late
timestamp_correction.convention: ur_joint_states row clock = t_rel_s - tau before the nearest-timestamp lookup (master frame at t reads the ur row stamped t + tau)
timestamp_correction.stale_tail_rule: a master frame k is kept iff cam1_t[k] + tau <= ur_joint_states t_rel_s[-1]; the trailing frames without a real joint sample at or after their corrected lookup time would otherwise repeat the last ur row while the arm is still moving, so the whole frame (state, action, cam1, cam2, both depth streams) is dropped. Per-episode count: n_frames_dropped_stale_tail.
